en-US.name: Agentdeck
en-US.subtitle: Your coding agents, in your pocket
en-US.shortDescription: Drive Claude Code, Codex and Gemini on your computers from your phone.
en-US.promotionalText: Start a task on the train, approve the edit from the queue, ship the pull request from the couch. Your agents keep running on your own computers.
en-US.description:
Agentdeck lets you drive the coding agents running on your own computers (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI) from your phone.

• Start a task in a fresh branch on any of your computers, and watch the agent work as it streams.
• Approve or deny what it wants to do, from a notification.
• Review what changed, read the code with syntax highlighting, and ask about a specific line.
• Run the repo's scripts, follow their logs, and open the app it's building in a live preview.
• Commit, push, and create and merge a pull request the agent drafted.
• Several accounts per agent: see each one's usage, and hand a chat to another when one hits its limit.

Your code stays on your computers. Agents run there with your own logins; the app talks to them end to end encrypted through a relay that never sees your chats. Install the free, open-source agentdeck CLI on each computer (npm install -g agentdeck), sign in with the same email, and your computers show up in the app.
en-US.contentRating: 4+ / Everyone: no user-generated content is shared with other users
